brand.name: DataEntropy
brand.tagline: Practical Data Skills. Real Career Impact.

prompt: Write a thank-you note to my teacher.
tokenNote: token = a word or word piece
probNote: every token it knows gets a probability (illustrative)
attentionNote: attention = looking back at related words
trainingNote: learned from huge amounts of text

scenes.headline:
How does AI *write*
a reply?
scenes.voiceover: How does an AI chatbot actually *write* its reply?

scenes.headline:
No answer lookup.
It *predicts* the next piece.
scenes.voiceover: It doesn't look up answers. It *predicts* text, piece by piece.

scenes.headline:
Text → *tokens* →
a probability per token
scenes.voiceover: Text becomes *tokens*, word pieces. It rates every possible next token.

scenes.headline:
*Attention* looks back,
one token at a time
scenes.voiceover: *Attention* looks back at related words, like teacher, then picks one.

scenes.headline:
Learned from *lots of text*.
Can still be wrong.
scenes.voiceover: It learned patterns from huge amounts of text, so *double-check* facts.
Follow *DataEntropy* to learn more AI, explained simply.
